bio:
EYES FRONT, MAGGOT! IF YOU'RE READING MY FILE, YOU BETTER BE PAYIN' ATTENTION!

FIGHTING WITH ME, SGT. SLUGG, MEANS YOU GOTTA OBEY MY THREE RULES FOR COMBAT.

RULE #1: HIT THE ENEMY AS HARD YOU CAN.
RULES #2 & #3: REPEAT #1 UNTIL THEY'RE A RED STREAK ON THE FLOOR.

NOW FALL OUT.
